question: Should the v0.1.x compatibility guidance be reduced to the tokens shipped in v0.1.0, or should the expanded token contract wait for a new matching package release?
rationale: Both paths can restore compatibility, but choosing whether to amend guidance or advance the released package requires ownership of the upstream release contract.

options.title: Version-gate the guidance
options.body: Keep v0.1.x guidance within the released v0.1.0 token surface and regenerate this PR from the corrected upstream source.

options.title: Release the expanded contract
options.body: Publish the CSS containing the eight additional tokens, update the documented supported version, and regenerate the downstream skills afterward.

recommendation.title: Version-gate the guidance
recommendation.body: Keep v0.1.x guidance within the released v0.1.0 token surface and regenerate this PR from the corrected upstream source.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the compatibility investigation and are the clearest available routing candidate for coordinating the upstream source and release contract.
